pages.title: A Dry Store
pages.text: Drying connects the garden to brewing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A Silo dries grain; JEI shows the Dried Wheat recipe. Collect the completed output, rather than placing an empty silo.

pages.title: Dry grain in a silo
pages.text: Fill the Silo with dryable grain and open its hatch after processing. Some other materials, including Podzol, also have drying recipes.

pages.title: Prepare dried brewing grain
pages.text: Dry wheat, barley, corn or oats in a Silo. The chosen brewing recipe specifies which dried grain it needs.
